name: Analysis at Various Prices
name_zh: 不同报价下的估值分析表（AVP）
summary: The M&A pitchbook AVP table: offer price levels as columns; premiums to reference prices, implied equity value, EV and implied multiples as rows — all computed live, offer column highlighted.
summary_zh: 并购项目书的核心表格：列为不同报价，行为相对参考价的溢价、隐含股权价值、企业价值与隐含估值倍数，全部实时计算，突出当前股价列与建议报价列。
description_zh: “不同报价下的估值分析”（Analysis at Various Prices）是并购建议书、董事会材料与公平意见书的标准表格。每一列是一个报价（options.prices 列表、{from, to, step} 区间，或绑定数据集的价格字段，可带“初始报价 / 修订报价”等列标签）；行依次为相对当前股价、30 日成交量加权均价（VWAP）、52 周最高价、未受影响股价的溢价 /（折价），隐含股权价值（报价 × 稀释股数）、净负债与隐含企业价值，以及由 metrics 定义的 EV / EBITDA、P/E 等隐含倍数——所有数字由组件根据 shares、netDebt、metrics 实时计算。当前股价列与建议报价列（accent2）高亮；报价可绑定 @参数（如 offer: "@offer"），通过表头上方的步进器、点击价格表头或页面上的参数滑块调整，整张表平滑重算。悬停单元格显示计算过程（如 EV ÷ EBITDA = 倍数）。
best_for: M&A offer price discussions (board / special committee materials)
Showing premiums and implied multiples at a proposed offer price
avoid_when: Trading valuation without an offer context (use comps-table / football-field)

price.desc: Offer price per share of each column (only when a dataset is bound and options.prices is not set)

label.desc: Column tag above the price (e.g. 'Initial proposal')

kind.desc: 'current' | 'offer' | 'proposal' | 'level' — the current and offer rows set those columns unless options.current / offer are given

prices.desc: Price levels: [42.5, 45, …] or {from, to, step}; null = the bound dataset's price field (or six $2.50 steps from the current price). The current and offer prices are inserted when they are not levels

current.desc: Current share price or '@param' (default: the dataset row with kind 'current'); its column is highlighted

offer.desc: Proposed offer price or '@param' such as '@offer' (default: the dataset row with kind 'offer'); highlighted in accent-2

shares.desc: Diluted shares (m) or '@param' — needed for equity value, EV and EV multiples

netDebt.desc: Net debt (USD m) or '@param' added to the equity value; negative = net cash

references.desc: [{label, value, note}] premium rows (current, 30-day VWAP, 52-week high, unaffected); value may be an '@param'; [] = premium to current only

metrics.desc: [{label, value, kind, group, name, format, metricFormat, note}] implied multiple rows: kind 'ev' = EV / value (EBITDA, revenue), 'equity' = equity value / value (net income), 'price' = price / value (EPS); consecutive rows with the same group get a section heading; name labels the tooltip divisor

showBridge.desc: Show the net debt and implied EV rows under the equity value

priceLabel.desc: Label of the price header row

netCashLabel.desc: Row label used when net debt is negative

currentLabel.desc: Tag of the current-price column (and the default premium row)

units.desc: Units caption in the header corner

valueFormat.desc: Equity value / net debt / EV format (USD m)

multipleFormat.desc: Default implied multiple format (zero / negative denominators show n.m.)

metricFormat.desc: Basis-column format of ev / equity metrics (default: valueFormat; 'price' metrics use priceFormat)

signColors.desc: true: premiums in the positive colour, discounts in the negative colour | 'neg': discounts only | false

footnotes.desc: Extra footnote lines under the table

autoNotes.desc: Note on the diluted share count and net debt used

stepper.desc: Offer price stepper (− / +) with the premium to current above the table, when an offer is set

clickToOffer.desc: Click a price header to make it the offer (sets the bound @param, else a local override)

tooltip.desc: Hover tooltip with the calculation behind each figure

paramDefaults.desc: Fallback values for '@param' options the report does not define (e.g. {"offer": 52}); they are then defined in the store and shared with sliders

interactions: Offer stepper (− / +) and click-a-price-header to move the offer; sets the bound @param so sliders and other blocks follow
Live recompute with number tweening when bound @params change
Hovered column highlight + tooltip with the calculation (price ÷ reference − 1, price × shares, EV ÷ EBITDA)
Rows rise in on first reveal; a moved offer column fades in
